field.label: Enable quota alerts
field.help: Write deduplicated threshold and projection alerts to the system log.

field.label: Alert when projected usage exceeds quota
field.help: Also alert when the projected cycle total would exceed the quota, before the threshold is actually reached.

field.label: Alert repeat interval (hours)
field.help: Minimum gap before the same alert is repeated. Prevents one sustained condition filling the log.

field.label: Enable HTTPS webhook notifications
field.help: Send alerts to an HTTPS webhook. HTTP is refused.

field.label: Webhook URL
field.help: HTTPS endpoint to post alerts to.

field.label: Webhook format
field.help: Payload shape: generic, Discord, Slack, Telegram, or Home Assistant.

field.label: Webhook recipient / Telegram chat ID
field.help: Channel, chat or entity the chosen format needs, where applicable.

field.label: Enable scheduled webhook reports
field.help: Email a periodic summary in addition to alerts.

field.label: Enable SMTP email notifications
field.help: Send alerts and summaries by email over SMTP with STARTTLS.

field.label: Email recipient
field.help: Recipient address for alerts and summaries.

field.label: SMTP username
field.help: SMTP username, if the server requires authentication.

field.label: SMTP password
field.help: SMTP password. Stored in the configuration, so use a dedicated account.
